name: sage of the maze
mana cost: {2}{G}
types: creature elf wizard
power toughness: 1/3
activated[1]: {T}: add two mana in any combination of colors.
activated[2]: {T}: until end of turn, target land you control becomes an X/X citizen creature with haste in addition to its other types, where X is twice the number of gates you control. activate only as a sorcery.
activated[3]: tap an untapped gate you control: untap CARDNAME.
